sentence_1_it: Tom era sempre geloso del fratello più giovane perché sapeva che Jack era il ragazzo dagli occhi azzurri della madre.
sentence_1_en: Tom was always jealous of his younger brother because he knew Jack was their mother's blue-eyed boy.

sentence_1_it: Non dovete essere gelose del successo degli altri.
sentence_1_en: You must not be jealous of others' success.
